**Title:** Where the Phoenix Suns stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The Phoenix Suns in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #38 Devin Booker 59.3
- #59 Collin Gillespie 56.6
- #67 Mark Williams 55.4
- #108 Miles Bridges 51.5
- #132 Jordan Goodwin 48.6
- #149 Oso Ighodaro 47.4
- #174 Luke Kennard 45.7
- #181 Jalen Green 45.3

GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
